objects.summary: Owner starts an independent operating-model challenge while the Chat-side verdict remains sealed, requiring one decision-grade verdict and no product/runtime mutation.

Codex independently recommends BOUNDED_AUTONOMY_RECOMMENDED: one resumable evidence/engineering orchestrator with science, authority, promotion and independent-review gates retained. Remote Pass-B/WP facts remain REPORTED/UNKNOWN where locally inaccessible.

Owner discloses the pre-frozen Chat blind verdict HYBRID_AUTONOMY_RECOMMENDED. Both designs reject unrestricted autonomy, preserve external gates, park blocked lanes and continue independent actionable work, and require CODEX_SELF_PASS != INDEPENDENT_PASS.

Post-disclosure synthesis finds HYBRID vs BOUNDED terminologically different but substantively aligned. Canonical safer formulation is bounded autonomous orchestrator. Anti-loop is revised around material evidence deltas; blocker parking checks shared premises/join dependencies; writes are limited to reversible pre-authorized non-deploying units.

Owner orders a further adversarial synthesis of both autonomy designs, specifically attacking silent builder-validator collapse, Git write authority, WP1/WP2/WP3 contamination, minimum persisted state and independent-review transitions; analysis only, no execution.

Owner starts the bounded autonomous continuity mission: first prove exact WP1/WP2/WP3 identities from primary evidence, then take the highest-value lawful reversible unit, returning only at bounded stop or genuine gate.

First autonomous run stops at BLOCK_EXACT_REMOTE_IDENTITIES_UNAVAILABLE due shallow checkout/403. WP1 is parked; WP2/WP3 remain unknown rather than guessed. Mission state is persisted with no boundary violations.

Owner introduces a GitHub-native remote evidence bridge: Pass-B roadmap/topology and immutable base are verified, WP1 identity supplied, autonomy evidence refs exposed, and REMOTE_EVIDENCE_REQUEST becomes the lawful mechanism when local history is inaccessible instead of globally stopping the mission.

Codex resumes with bridge facts. WP1 remains parked; WP2 stays BLOCKED because platform-write evidence does not prove lease recovery/evaluator/isolated sink lineage; WP3 remains partial with promotion/install/deploy/runtime UNKNOWN. Four exact remote evidence requests are persisted and boundary violations remain none.

cross_object_findings.finding: Independent Chat and Codex reviews converge on one durable orchestrator with externally gated science/authority/promotion, despite different labels. This supports the operating model without mutual-answer contamination.

A fixed attempt-count stop law is rejected as potentially premature; continuation is instead conditioned on whether materially new evidence can change the decision, while blocked lanes can be parked after shared-premise and join checks.

Autonomous writes are limited to identity-verified, pre-authorized, reversible, non-deploying evidence/tests/narrow repairs. Self-merge, scientific-semantic mutation, promotion, deployment and runtime mutation remain forbidden.

The first autonomous mission still globally blocked on shallow local history. Introducing a connector-backed evidence bridge lets the orchestrator request decisive remote objects precisely instead of restarting, guessing, or requiring a full local clone.

WP2 is correctly kept BLOCKED: a scheduled GitHub write receipt alone cannot prove task-to-lease/retry-to-runner-to-evaluator-to-isolated-sink continuity. WP3 is likewise kept UNKNOWN beyond the evidenced technical chain.
